passages.title: 출입 카드 재발급 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Security Office
To: Tina Brooks
Subject: Your New ID Card

Dear Ms. Brooks,

Your replacement ID card is ready. Please pick it up at the security office on the first floor between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m.

Bring a photo ID, such as a driver's license. Your old card has been turned off and can no longer open doors. The replacement fee of $10 will be taken from this month's pay.

Security Office

choices: To say a new ID card is ready
questions.exKo: 재발급된 사원증을 찾아가라는 안내 메일입니다.
Bring a photo ID, such as a driver's license라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What is true about the old card?
choices: It can be kept as a spare
questions.exKo: Your old card has been turned off이라고 명시되어 있습니다.

passages.title: 고객 만족 설문 요청 메일
passages.passage:
From: River Airlines
To: Carl Owens
Subject: How Was Your Flight?

Dear Mr. Owens,

Thank you for flying with us to Denver last week. We would love to hear about your trip.

The short survey below takes about three minutes. As a thank-you, everyone who completes it this month will be entered to win 10,000 travel miles.

Your feedback helps us serve you better.

River Airlines Customer Team

questions.q: What is the purpose of the email?
questions.exKo: 지난 항공편에 대한 설문 참여를 요청하는 메일입니다.

questions.q: How long does the survey take?
questions.exKo: takes about three minutes라고 안내합니다.
entered to win 10,000 travel miles에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 탕비실 냉장고 정리 공지
passages.passage:
REFRIGERATOR CLEANING NOTICE

The break room refrigerator will be cleaned every Friday at 5 p.m. Any food without a name and date label will be thrown away at that time.

Labels are available in the drawer next to the refrigerator. Please take home anything you want to keep before Friday evening.

Thank you for keeping our shared space fresh.

Office Management

questions.q: What happens every Friday at 5 p.m.?
questions.exKo: 매주 금요일 5시에 냉장고를 정리한다는 공지입니다.

questions.q: Which food will be thrown away?
choices: Food without a name and date label
questions.exKo: 이름과 날짜 라벨이 없는 음식은 폐기됩니다.

choices: In the drawer next to the refrigerator
questions.exKo: in the drawer next to the refrigerator라고 안내합니다.

passages.title: 연말 자선 모금 공지
passages.passage:
HOLIDAY CHARITY DRIVE

From December 1 to 15, we are collecting new toys and books for children at the City Children's Home. Donation boxes are in the lobby and on each floor near the elevators.

Please donate only new, unwrapped items. The company will match every donation with a cash gift to the home. Last year we collected over 300 items — let's beat that record!

Volunteer Committee

questions.exKo: 어린이집에 보낼 새 장난감과 책을 모으고 있습니다.

questions.q: What kind of items should be donated?
questions.exKo: only new, unwrapped items라고 명시합니다.

choices: Match donations with a cash gift
questions.exKo: match every donation with a cash gift에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 구두 수선점 광고
passages.passage:
HEEL & SOLE SHOE REPAIR

Don't throw away your favorite shoes — repair them! We fix heels, soles, and zippers, usually while you wait.

Business customers: drop off shoes before work and pick them up the same day. Most repairs cost between $8 and $25. Find us in the subway station under Grand Tower, open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. weekdays.

questions.exKo: 굽·밑창·지퍼를 고치는 구두 수선점 광고입니다.

choices: Drop off shoes before work and pick up the same day
questions.exKo: 출근 전에 맡기고 당일 찾아갈 수 있다고 안내합니다.

choices: In the subway station under Grand Tower
On the top floor of Grand Tower
questions.exKo: in the subway station under Grand Tower라고 명시합니다.

passages.title: 사무실 화분 관리 서비스 광고
passages.passage:
GREEN DESK — PLANTS FOR YOUR OFFICE

Studies show plants make workplaces calmer and more pleasant. Green Desk delivers office plants and takes care of them for you.

Our team visits every two weeks to water, trim, and replace any unhealthy plants at no extra cost. Plans start at $49 per month for five plants. Call today for a free office visit and quote.

questions.q: How often does the team visit?
questions.exKo: visits every two weeks라고 안내합니다.

questions.q: What is replaced at no extra cost?
questions.exKo: replace any unhealthy plants at no extra cost에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 청소년 코딩 교실 기사
passages.passage:
STONEBRIDGE — The public library began free coding classes for teenagers this month. Twenty students meet every Saturday morning to build simple games and websites.

Local software company ByteWorks lends laptops and sends two engineers as volunteer teachers. "We hope some students will join our summer internship later," said engineer Maya Ross. The library plans an adult class next year.

choices: Free coding classes at a library
questions.exKo: 도서관이 시작한 청소년 무료 코딩 교실에 관한 기사입니다.
lends laptops and sends two engineers as volunteer teachers라고 설명합니다.

questions.q: What is planned for next year?
questions.exKo: The library plans an adult class next year에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 역 앞 무인 세탁소 개점 기사
passages.passage:
KENDALL — A 24-hour self-service laundry opened near Kendall Station last week. The shop has 16 washers and 12 dryers, and payment is by card or phone only.

Owner Victor Shaw chose the location for commuters. "People start a wash, catch their train, and pick up clothes on the way home," he said. A phone app tells customers when their machine finishes.

questions.exKo: 역 근처에 24시간 무인 세탁소가 문을 열었다는 기사입니다.
payment is by card or phone only라고 명시합니다.

questions.q: What does the phone app do?
choices: Tells customers when their machine finishes
questions.exKo: tells customers when their machine finishes에서 확인됩니다.

passages.title: 방문객 주차 안내 문자
passages.passage:
Gate Security (9:40 A.M.)
Good morning. A visitor named Mr. Fuller has arrived for you. He asks where to park.

Amy Zhou (9:42 A.M.)
Please direct him to visitor spots 5 to 8, next to the main entrance.

Gate Security (9:43 A.M.)
Spot 6 is free. I'll guide him there and give him a visitor pass.

Amy Zhou (9:44 A.M.)
Thank you. I'll meet him in the lobby in five minutes.

questions.q: Why did security message Ms. Zhou?
questions.exKo: 방문객이 주차 위치를 물어 안내를 요청한 메시지입니다.
Spot 6 is free. I'll guide him there라고 답합니다.

choices: Meet the visitor in the lobby
questions.exKo: I'll meet him in the lobby in five minutes라고 말합니다.

passages.title: 에어컨 고장 신고 문자
passages.passage:
Leo Marsh (2:05 P.M.)
Hi, Facilities? The air conditioner in Office 410 is blowing warm air. It's getting hot in here.

Facilities Desk (2:08 P.M.)
Thanks for reporting. A technician is on the 4th floor now — he can stop by within 20 minutes.

Leo Marsh (2:09 P.M.)
Great. Should we move to another room?

Facilities Desk (2:10 P.M.)
Not needed. It's usually a quick filter fix. Please keep the windows closed so he can test the cooling.

choices: The air conditioner blows warm air
questions.exKo: 410호 에어컨에서 더운 바람이 나온다는 신고입니다.
he can stop by within 20 minutes라고 안내합니다.
